scope: Frozen offline analysis definitions before new perspective MetalFX/Aurora outputs. No new hard quality bounds are authored here. Existing original quality bounds remain mandatory; artifact diagnostics support matched image/motion review.
population: New shared reverse-Z perspective PBR MASK fixture only. Do not compare retained orthographic MetalFX scores directly to Aurora.
first_gate: New perspective MetalFX must reproduce a relevant ORIGINAL palm-quality failure before proceeding to an Aurora advantage comparison; a newly authored artifact diagnostic alone is not that reproduction.
candidate_identity: Pinned Aurora WGSL port of FSR3.1 at ee458fbf1d95e98c5b3a55c0027a523bb28d7e7f. RCAS None/unsharpened and ordinary setting are distinct arms, no sweep or assumed equivalence to native AMD SDK binaries.

data.metric_domain: Unclamped linear RGB reconstructed output texture, alpha recorded separately
data.sampling: Each algorithm owns valid phase history and independent warmed final-camera references. Stop deadlines count 18/36 stopped submitted worlds and use actual matching phase, not a fixed phase ID.
data.metadata: Keep zero-based frame indices separate from one-based submitted world IDs; preserve reset, jitter, dimensions, exposure, projection/depth and motion conventions.
data.images: One identical documented preview transfer for both arms. Lossless raw arrays remain authoritative for values hidden by preview clipping. Native0 is not an exact anti-aliased image oracle.

overshoot.definition: Per-channel positive distance outside the known foreground/background convex color range for the authored constant-color palm. Record peak, p95, mean and fraction above the review reference level. No output clamp before measuring.

halo_false_coverage.definition: In scored ROI pixels outside a two-output-pixel Chebyshev dilation of independent nonzero ground-truth foreground coverage, record RGB residual from known background and signed foreground-color-direction contribution. Report positive and negative residuals separately.
halo_false_coverage.report: Peak/p95/mean background residual and fraction above reference level; fraction/area is descriptive, not a new pass tolerance.

localized_trails.definition: At stopped-world counts 18/36, use analytically old-only/disoccluded pixels and the algorithm's own warmed matching-phase final-camera reference. Project residual output toward that algorithm's initial-position warm history, keeping the existing denominator validity guard. Report p95/peak residue and affected-pixel fraction, alongside unchanged mean old-history bound.

selection: Quality first: all existing target bounds plus matched review showing no new unacceptable artifact. New diagnostics explain observations and are not retroactively promoted into invented numeric pass/fail gates. Cost is considered only after the quality gate. No production integration or presumed Aurora advantage follows from compiling the port.
